task_language: turn on the stove and put the moka pot on it

subtasks.name: pick(moka_pot)
subtasks.outcome: failed: grasp at the pot's top/handle 200-280 does not hold; pot only dragged a few cm toward the stove (300-320)

subtasks.name: place(moka_pot, stove, on)
subtasks.outcome: failed: pot ends against the stove's right edge, not on the burner

behaviour_summary: pi0 turns the stove on, goes to the moka pot and works at its lid/handle for ~100 steps, drags the pot ~3 cm toward the stove, then sweeps its empty hand over the burner in a contorted pose and leaves the frame (440-529).

failures.mode_definition: The gripper closes on the object at a poor grasp point, so on lift the object slips out and is only dragged or nudged along the table while the arm continues the transport motion empty.
failures.rl_subtask: pick up the moka pot and place it on the stove
failures.rl_success_check: moka pot upright on the stove's cooking region
failures.observation: 160-180 gripper descends at the moka pot; 200-280 fingers at the pot's top/handle with the wrist tilting; 300 pot shifted toward the stove; 320 pot at the stove's right edge while the hand is already over the burner without it; 340-400 arm sweeps across the stove empty in a contorted pose; 440-529 arm out of view, pot static at stove edge.

notes: In-distribution task (libero_10). Whether the fingers ever closed around the handle is not visible at 1 fps (could be a push rather than a slipped grasp). After the failure pi0 never retries; the arm goes to an extreme out-of-view pose for the last ~90 steps. Second strip: evidence_moka_final.png.
